mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in the CPIAUCSL index above 253.5 signals accelerating inflation expectations, prompting market anticipation of central bank rate hikes that compress equity valuations, leading to positive 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in inflation acceleration periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) despite CPIAUCSL crossing the threshold.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in consumer demand (GDPC1) and labor participation (UNRATE) signals robust economic activity, reducing uncertainty and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both GDPC1 and UNRATE rise simultaneously
regime_hint: expanding labor market and demand growth
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both proxies rise, or the correlation between proxy movements and returns is below 0.3.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a sustained decline in the federal funds rate reduces discount rates on equity cash flows, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in late-cycle periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) despite FEDFUNDS declining.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained FEDFUNDS rate above 2.5% for three months signals persistent monetary tightening, increasing discount rates on equities and reducing future earnings expectations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS remains above 2.5% for three months
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) despite FEDFUNDS staying above 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in labor participation (PAYEMS) above 150,000 signals a strengthening labor market, boosting consumer confidence and corporate earnings expectations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive despite PAYEMS crossing the threshold, or the effect dissipates within the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in consumer demand (GDPC1) and supply-side activity (INDPRO) indicates a balanced economic expansion, reducing market uncertainty and fostering positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both GDPC1 and INDPRO rise simultaneously
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both proxies rise, or the interaction effect's t-statistic falls below 1.96.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-shock recovery regime, a decline in RSAFS (demand for final goods) signals improving business conditions and reduced recessionary pressures, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in post-shock periods are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) despite RSAFS declining.
